svg.text: · Adding one tool means editing the same name in 7 places (generic) or 3 places (airline). Nothing checks that the lists agree.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · unsupported_request() hardcodes all five capabilities — a session with tools disabled still offers them out loud.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · A half-registered tool degrades silently: a missing service → generic retry line; a missing formatter branch → "I completed the check."

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · airline/thinker.py and generic/backend.py are two copies of one lifecycle that have drifted — airline has no deadline, no stale guard, no parameter validation.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · The “shared” src/ layer is not domain-neutral: src/tts_filter.py imports airline.airports, pipeline.py imports airline.domain at module scope, and pipeline.py:72 keeps an unreachable airline fallback.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · Filler speech follows two different trust rules: the generic domain selects it in Python, the airline domain speaks whatever the model put in filler_text.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · tools_available is client-passable (utils.py:65, :488) and is not re-bound from the registry — a session body can enable a metered tool the prompt never declared.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
